sample_order: per locale, ascending sha256(seed + TAB + product_locale + TAB + product_id), then product_id; concatenate es, jp, us
input: pinned ESCI product titles only; no query or judgment partitions opened
device: MPS if available, otherwise explicit CPU; no unsupported-operator MPS-to-CPU fallback
pooling: attention-mask-aware mean of last_hidden_state, then L2 normalization; eval and inference modes; eager attention
warmup: one full batch per locale before timing that locale, including after restart
memory: kernel-reported process maximum RSS including load/warmup; separate maximum MPS allocator/driver observations after forward calls, not true GPU peaks and not additive to RSS
recovery: kill a worker at the boundary after two committed shards, restart, verify completed shard hashes unchanged and compare all resumed vectors to a clean full pilot
projection: sum locale catalog counts times measured locale seconds per title; rough compute-stage planning estimate, excluding download, model load, warmup, index construction and thermal drift; min/max observed shard rates are descriptive bounds, not a confidence interval
completion: all locales finish with finite unit vectors; resume preserves committed work and meets numerical tolerance; report throughput, truncation, RSS, observed MPS memory, storage and projection honestly
scope: compatibility and resource feasibility only; no dense index, retrieval quality, fine-tuning, fusion or official test exposure
